reader.notes: Re-read after kb/Work PB2338 moved ScreenRangeOperands into WhenPhraseBinder. The class of each end comes from the one Table-2 lattice (IntrinsicArgumentRules.ClassOf projected by TableTwoClass); a figurative end abstains from the lattice and is screened by CanShareClass, ZERO pairing with any class. SPACE outside MOVE is class alphanumeric by the recorded determination D-85-SPACE-CLASS. The message names 'alphanumeric or national' at 85 (cosmetic).

refuter.evidence: rfevneg-001 refuses (COBOL2107) GRP THRU 9 (a group is class alphanumeric), FUNCTION CHAR (66) THRU 9, 1 THRU FUNCTION UPPER-CASE ("A"), NE THRU 9 (numeric-edited is class alphanumeric), LOW-VALUE THRU 9, A THRU FUNCTION UPPER-CASE (A) (alphabetic against an alphanumeric function) and QUOTE THRU A; rfev-001 accepts and evaluates GRP ranges against nonnumeric literals (G1), FUNCTION ORD and FUNCTION MIN numeric ranges (G2), QUOTE THRU "Z" (G3), ALL "A" THRU ALL "Z" (G4), a numeric-edited item THRU an alphanumeric item (G5) and FUNCTION CHAR (66) THRU HIGH-VALUE (G6). 'OK  §1985:IV.4.3.3  (4.3.3 Concept of Classes of Data)  the text is in the clause; it lies in p2'. The open point is SPACE: the reader's evneg refuses SPACE THRU A3 (a PIC A item) as two classes, but the only 1985 sentence that classes SPACE is in MOVE: 'OK  §1985:VI.6.19.4 GR3  (6.19.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR3'. Read that way SPACE THRU A3 is one class and the refusal rejects legal source; the compiler takes SPACE as alphanumeric, the recorded determination D-85-SPACE-CLASS (docs/conformance/3/D-85-SPACE-CLASS.md).
refuter.corrected: CONFORMS for every operand the 1985 text classes; the SPACE arm rests on D-85-SPACE-CLASS, not on the 1985 text.

adjudication.reason: The doubt is rejected: outside MOVE the 1985 text gives SPACE no class; GnuCOBOL has no rule; IBM Enterprise COBOL treats SPACE as an alphanumeric literal, which is what the compiler does. Recorded as the determination D-85-SPACE-CLASS. The re-read after kb/Work PB2338 raised the same doubt and nothing new.
